description: Test suite for the CIDR range allocator in Kubernetes, including tests for CIDR allocation, release, and node deletion handling.

methods.name: TestOccupyPreExistingCIDR
methods.description: Tests the allocator's ability to occupy pre-existing CIDRs on nodes, including success and failure scenarios.

methods.name: TestAllocateOrOccupyCIDRSuccess
methods.description: Tests successful CIDR allocation, filtering, and handling of dual-stack CIDRs.

methods.name: TestAllocateOrOccupyCIDRFailure
methods.description: Tests failure cases during CIDR allocation, such as exhaustion of CIDRs.

methods.name: TestReleaseCIDRSuccess
methods.description: Tests releasing and recycling CIDRs, ensuring they are freed and reallocated correctly.

methods.name: TestNodeDeletionReleaseCIDR
methods.description: Tests CIDR release logic when nodes are deleted or marked for deletion.
